sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:1
items.html: The Yesod, the womb, and the vessel within her, within which the MAN will afterward be: This has already been explained — that at the first intercourse he brings back her posterior, which is her AHP, and brings it back from the place of BYA, to complete the ten Sefirot of the Nukva [female] of Atzilut; and these are the discernment of her new NHY that she now attains, as above in the adjacent item. You also know that clinging to this posterior are also the discernments of the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous — for so they were clinging to one another while in BYA. But at this first intercourse they are still without depiction, for the discernment of the upper one of the souls of the righteous — namely the Nukva — must first be completed; only afterward, once the Nukva has already attained her full completeness from the first intercourse, are the anterior vessels depicted in the discernment of MAN within the completed posterior of the Nukva — which are the Yesod, the womb, and the vessel that raises the MAN within her. And this is what he said: that afterward the MAN will be within it.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:2
items.html: One name BON, which is the Gevurot mentioned, and it becomes a vessel in her: Meaning, the discernment of the square of the HaVaYaH of BON, which is AB and KADEM, whose Gematria is RIU, as above in the words of the ARI, item 10.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:3
items.html: The Ruach that the husband places in her at the first coupling: For the completed posterior contains within it the discernment of a vessel and the discernment of light. Therefore two things are discerned in them: a vessel for raising the MAN, and the light within the vessel, which is the Ruach that the husband places in her at the first intercourse. And all the new MAN that are born and emerge from there take with them a portion of that light — namely, of that Ruach.
